text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан triumphs against Biwa
Hayahide in an
impressive show!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The sisters promise to have a rematch.
Although
in awe of her sister's
performance, Бива Хаяхидэ
is confident
that Нарита Брайан will be the one
chasing
after her next time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
